T: Find your one thing. Then find the chuckwagon.
D: Three city friends in a midlife crisis sign up for a cattle drive holiday.
P: Serve the mains when the friends take over the cooking on the trail.
S: Strips of beef jerky, sharp cheddar cut into chunks, crackers and a big bowl of salted peanuts set out on the ranch house porch.
the first night out on the drive
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes, honey butter.
the guys' life back in the city
Mini bagels split and toasted, spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill.
M: Beef chuck diced and browned, braised with dried chillies, cumin, garlic, tomato and beans for 3 hours. Cornbread.
Rib eye seasoned heavily and seared in cast iron over hot coals, rested, with beans simmered with bacon and molasses and potatoes fried in the steak pan with onion.
W: sitting under the stars with the herd
Big marshmallows toasted on sticks over the fire until blistered, sandwiched with a square of milk chocolate between two digestive biscuits and pressed so it melts.
K: Coarse ground coffee boiled in a pot for 4 minutes, a splash of cold water to settle the grounds, poured black into tin mugs.

s.how: Set out strips of 100g beef jerky, 250g sharp cheddar cut into chunks, crackers and a big bowl of 200g salted peanuts on the ranch house porch.

s.note: the guys' life back in the city
s.how: Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread with 150g cream cheese and top with 150g smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill. A little taste of home for the city boys.

m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 4 soaked and blitzed dried chillies, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves, a tin of tomatoes and a tin of kidney beans. Braise 3 hours. Serve with a skillet of cornbread.

w.note: sitting under the stars with the herd
w.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire until blistered. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 digestive biscuits, 100g chocolate and 32 biscuits in all, and press so it melts.

d.how: Bring 1.2L water to the boil in a pot and stir in 80g coarse ground coffee. Boil 4 minutes, then splash in a little cold water to settle the grounds. Pour black into tin mugs, carefully.
